fields.description: The value held on the employee's category field, spelt exactly as it is stored. For DTC these are the Employment Type records, Regular and Contract.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: Arriving within this many minutes of shift start counts as on time, for this category only. Contract staff are given 15 where regular staff get 6.
fields.label: Grace Minutes

fields.description: Whether this category earns red and green marks. Off for contract staff: they still lose quarters for time missed, but carry no marks either way.
fields.label: Earns Marks

fields.description: Whether this category earns the monthly leave class. Off for contract staff, who are paid pro-rata on days present.
fields.label: Earns Leave Credits
